  judge llm: model from the run, samples 1*, per criterion*, timeout 2m*; * marks a default
  worst-case grading time: 24m (agent 1 x 20m + llm 2 x 2m; in sequence, before retries), plus the scripts of the task, which no [verifier] timeout bounds
  warning: cite is "independent", but an llm judge cites only its evidence, and every item here is the solver's: add tests or a runtime-recorded item (request-record, screenshots, video, a world stream), or judge it with an agent that can run the work (verifier/rubric.json criteria[1])
  warning: the agent judge has no token budget ([verifier.judges.agent] budget = { tokens = ... }): here it is bounded by its timeout, 20m, but purpose = "rl" and delivery grade require one (task.md)
